name: Bellevue Palace
insider_take: Where Swiss political power meets Belle Époque elegance in the heart of the capital.
whats_special: This historic palace hotel has been the preferred residence of world leaders and diplomats since 1913. Located directly across from the Federal Parliament, it's where crucial political decisions have been discussed over champagne in the legendary VIP suites. The hotel's original Art Nouveau elevator and hand-painted ceilings remain untouched from its opening day.
pro_tip: Book a Parliament-facing room during session weeks to witness Swiss democracy in action, or visit the terrace bar at sunset when the Bernese Alps create a stunning backdrop behind the medieval Old Town.
dont_miss: The UNESCO World Heritage Old Town is a 3-minute walk away—explore the famous Zytglogge clock tower and covered arcades. The hotel's Michelin-recommended restaurant offers the city's best fondue with ingredients sourced from local Alpine farms.
pros: Historic luxury palace hotel in Swiss capital
Elegant Belle Époque architecture and interiors
Walking distance to Old Town UNESCO site
cons: Premium pricing for luxury heritage property
